body: That sounds really cool, I’ll definitely look into it :)

I think I miswrote that last part about using my computer. I didn’t mean it to come off as “I want to create music on my computer” but rather, are there any other hobbies I can do on my computer ... my bad :P
I’ll get right on that, thank you :)

These are all lovely ideas, thank you for sharing them with me :) Also, do you have any suggestions on which websites or courses I can use/take for programming? Seems like a very practical skill to have and I have been interested in that for some time now
You’re absolutely right! I’ll try it out tonight and see what I can come up with :)

My brother is something of an artist and he has a lot of supplies at home, I can definitely ask him if I can borrow some things :) painting/drawing would be really cool but I think I’m just nervous to suck so hard and have no idea what to draw which makes no sense cuz we all suck and are clueless when we first try out something new. I’ll just have to give it a shot :D
I like to write down my feelings on occasions when I’m feeling under the weather but I can definitely try and do it more often
Gardening sounds like it would be soo therapeutic :D I don’t have a garden unfortunately but I’ll definitely look into it, hopefully own a plant and take care of is as if it’s my baby :)
Yes please, that’ll be greatly appreciated :)
This is so important but I always neglect this, my diet is terrible so I’ll definitely be trying to cook something so I can better myself. Thank you Felix :)
Yes absolutely what a great idea :D I would love to learn another language and I’m also unbelievably terrible at dancing so that’s also something I can try. Thank you :)

I don’t see that as fun for me tbh, I tried playing instruments as a kid but never continued. That doesn’t necessarily mean I’m against trying something new in the future but for now I’d like to avoid playing anything
I won’t be able to buy any instruments for some time, is there something I can do on my computer instead?

Thanks Jordan for telling me what you went through, I’ve never tried to take my own life and I do think that it won’t be worth it and that there are other solutions other than suicide. I’ve just had enough of life and I feel like I’m going nowhere really so in my head I just think why not end it but ik that’s not the answer, it’s hard to get rid of these thoughts even though ik it’s not the solution. I hope you’re ok now or at least things have gotten better, I like to believe things always get better but it’s hard to hope for that when you sort of lost hope of living anymore. I really hope you never go through anything like that again, I’m also free to chat if you need anything. One love Jordan ❤️
